documented_class_mapping.0: space-empty — valid parking slot with no vehicle (free)
documented_class_mapping.1: space-occupied — valid parking slot containing a vehicle (occupancy, NOT correctness)

annotation_format: YOLOv8 normalized bounding boxes (.txt); rectangular approximations of original PKLot rotated rectangles
limitations: Labels are parking-slot occupancy states, not vehicle instances.
An occupied slot is NOT the same as a correctly parked car.
No wrong-parking class exists; wrong parking must use geometric overlap analysis.
Axis-aligned boxes approximate angled PKLot slots — geometry has rectangular approximation error.
Wrong-parking accuracy cannot be measured without a separately labeled evaluation set.

architecture_recommendation.Approach_A_slot_detection: SUPPORTED — train YOLOv8 on space-empty / space-occupied
architecture_recommendation.Approach_B_vehicle_detection: NOT directly supported — no vehicle boxes. Options: (1) remap occupied slots to a car class for approximate vehicle training; (2) use COCO-pretrained vehicle classes.
architecture_recommendation.Approach_C_wrong_parking_geometry: REQUIRED — no wrong-parking labels; use vehicle–slot overlap ratios.
what_needs_extra_info: vehicle-level boxes or segmentation for accurate car footprint
manually verified wrong-parking labels for classification metrics
original PKLot rotated rectangles / polygons for angled slots
